title: Asahikawa, Hokkaido — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Asahikawa, Hokkaido: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Asahikawa is a city in Hokkaido with a population of 340,000. Japan’s second-coldest major city, gateway to the Daisetsuzan National Park and home to the Asahiyama Zoo. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
